captions.instagram:
Concept redesign of a fictional motel. Not a client project.

A lot of small accommodation sites run a six-step booking engine that hides the rate until step three, then forgets the dates you typed in. People give up and ring the one up the road.

So we put the nightly rate up front, carried the chosen dates straight through to booking, and showed real rooms instead of a form.

Does your site do this? Free review at prycedigital.com/book

captions.linkedin:
Concept redesign: a fictional country motel homepage, rebuilt for the phone.

The old version is a six-step booking engine. It hides the nightly rate until step three, then asks you to type your dates in again. Every extra step is a chance to leave.

The new one shows the nightly rate up front, carries your chosen dates straight through to booking, and shows real rooms instead of a form.

Not a client project. If your booking page does any of this, I am happy to take a look: prycedigital.com/book
